name: He@rtstrings
source:
The story revolves around a matchmaker who can see everyone's red strings of fate, including hers! She thought it would be easy to find her soulmate, not until she found out she's connected to three different guys! How will she solve this mystery?

[From [url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/heartstrings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一位媒人展开，她能看见每个人的命运红线，包括自己的！她本以为，找到命中注定的另一半会很容易，直到发现自己的红线竟然同时连着三个不同的男人！她该如何解开这个谜团？

[摘自[url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/heartstrings]itch.io[/url]]
